what: In one slot of the photo panel pinned to the screen, step photos are stacked, and each time a step row passes the screen center, that step’s photo opens with a cut from the left (clip-path inset right 100% → 0, .45s power2.inOut). When it opens, the photo just before sinks from 1.1 → 1×, and scrolling back closes it the same way and returns it to 1.1×. Even if several steps are skipped, the photos in between open all at once. The step indicator (dot) marks only the current step is-on, and clicking it smoothly scrolls that step row to the screen center

options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.45,0,0.55,1”, default power2.inOut
options.scale: Size of the front photo before it sinks, default 1.1 — 1 means no sinking
options.from: Opening direction — left (default, opens from the left edge to the right)·right·top·bottom · corner (a triangle folded at the bottom-right corner unfolds to the top-left — brand) · circle-right (a circle at right center grows to 150%) · circle-bottom (circle at bottom center)
options.start: Where the step turns on, default top center (the head of the step row at screen center)
options.end: Position re-enabled when stepping back, default ”bottom center”
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Stacked photo panels (children) — in step order, the first one starts open
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo that changes size inside the panel (grandchild, if absent there is no sinking)
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Step rows (children) — usually one screen height each
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Step indicator (optional) — only the current step gets is-on and aria-current, pressing scrolls to that step
options.fx:step: Event fired from the element when the step changes (detail.index) — hook the step text rise-in here
options.narrow: The opening side used below 991px (same meaning as from), none by default — brand picker section is circle-right · narrow: circle-bottom
